title: Merit-Based Scholarship
content: Awarded to students with outstanding academic performance in the professional examinations. Renewable each year subject to maintaining the required GPA.
scholarship_eligibility: Top position holders in the professional examination with no failed subject.

title: Performance-Based Scholarship
content: Recognises consistent academic improvement and excellent conduct throughout the academic year.
scholarship_eligibility: Students showing marked improvement in results and good disciplinary record.

title: Distress / Need-Based Scholarship
content: Financial assistance for deserving students facing genuine financial hardship, subject to verification by the Student Affairs Office.
scholarship_eligibility: Verified financial need; supporting documents (income certificate) required.

title: Alumni Endowment Scholarship
content: Funded by the RMC alumni association for one deserving student per session.
scholarship_eligibility: Nominated on merit and need; one award per session.
